order_spend.name: order_spend

params.name: operator
params.note: payment key hash of the named key payment/script-operator

order_spend.firstNote: Applied compile-time params (from outer Apply chain) — applied first (innermost):
order_spend.notes: Large parameterised order-book spend validator (rules in aiken-v2/lib/order_book.ak). Redeemers Cancel = Constr 0 [], Fill = Constr 1 [amount, payout_index], Reprice = Constr 2 [new_unit_price]. Datum Constr 0 [maker address, sell_policy, sell_asset, unit_price, quantity, expires_at, memo]; a list datum fails with a MachineError (unConstrData). The decompiler's first note is 'Applied compile-time params' (two applied `con data` parameters); use order_fixed for the 'Outer Apply chain' note.

order_fixed.name: order_fixed
order_fixed.firstNote: Outer Apply chain — no compile-time params: all 1 argument(s) are
order_fixed.notes: Same logic, redeemers and datum as order_spend, with the operator key hash (payment/script-operator) and the fee (30 bps) compiled in as constants: no applied parameters, so the first decompiler note is 'Outer Apply chain — no compile-time params'.

burn_mint.name: burn_mint

params.name: admin
params.note: payment key hash of the named key payment/script-operator

params.name: max_supply
params.note: largest quantity one transaction may mint per asset name

burn_mint.firstNote: Applied compile-time params (from outer Apply chain) — applied first (innermost):
burn_mint.notes: Parameterised V2 minting policy. Redeemer Burn = Constr 1 [] passes when every quantity of the policy in tx.mint is negative (needs no signature and ignores any datum); MintTokens = Constr 0 [asset_name] needs the admin as required signer, exactly one minted entry with that name and 0 < quantity <= max_supply.

reward_ok.name: reward_ok
reward_ok.firstNote: Outer Apply chain — no compile-time params: all 1 argument(s) are
reward_ok.notes: V2 staking validator for zero withdrawals / script stake certificates. Redeemer Constr 0 [] passes; Constr 1 [] fails with the trace 'reward_ok: denied'; any other shape fails with a MachineError.

lock_spend.name: lock_spend
lock_spend.firstNote: Outer Apply chain — no compile-time params: all 1 argument(s) are
lock_spend.notes: Small V2 spend validator (reference-script friendly). Redeemer Unlock = Constr 1 [] passes when the spent input is among the inputs; Refund = Constr 0 [] fails with the trace 'lock_spend: refund is disabled'; Batch = Constr 2 [n] passes when exactly n inputs sit at the same script address; Sweep = Constr 3 [i] passes when output i goes to a key address with the input's lovelace minus the fee. The datum can be any Data.

spend_v3.name: spend_v3
spend_v3.notes: Small V3 time-lock vault. Needs an inline datum Constr 0 [owner key hash, unlock_after] that equals the spent output's inline datum. Withdraw = Constr 0 [] needs the owner as required signer and a validity range starting at or after unlock_after; Extend = Constr 1 [] fails with the trace 'spend_v3: extend is not supported'. Its hash is the reference_holder parameter of pool_mint_a.

pool_mint_a.name: pool_mint_a

params.name: owner
params.note: payment key hash of the named key payment/script-operator

params.name: reference_holder
params.note: script hash of spend_v3: the reference token goes to this script address

pool_mint_a.firstNote: Applied compile-time params (from outer Apply chain) — applied first (innermost):
pool_mint_a.notes: CIP-68 style pair policy. MintPair = Constr 0 [name, reference_output_index]: owner is a required signer; tx.mint under this policy is exactly {000643b0++name: 1, 000de140++name: 1}; output i holds the reference token at the spend_v3 script address with an inline datum Constr 0 [metadata map with byte keys 'name' and 'image', version 1, extra]. BurnPair = Constr 1 [name]: owner signs, both tokens burned (-1 each).

pool_mint_b.name: pool_mint_b

params.name: seed
params.note: blake2b-256 of the phrase "cardano-debug-mcp synthetic fixture seed output / pool_mint_b", output index 0: a UTxO set must contain this output (and the transaction spend it) for MintNft to pass

pool_mint_b.notes: One-shot NFT policy. MintNft = Constr 0 [name]: the seed output is spent and tx.mint under the policy is exactly {name: 1}. BurnNft = Constr 1 []: every quantity of the policy is negative.

guardrails.name: guardrails
guardrails.notes: Constitution-guardrails shape, one script with three handlers (propose / vote / publish share one hash). propose: redeemer must be a Plutus map (normally `Map []`); a ParameterChange passes when every changed parameter is inside the bounds listed in the source header (an empty change passes), a TreasuryWithdrawal passes up to 10,000,000 ada, anything else fails. vote: needs a required signer; a pool voter must itself sign, any other voter needs redeemer Constr 0 []. publish: DRep registration with a deposit of at least 100 ada, or a DRep update.

tiny.name: tiny
tiny.notes: Always succeeds: \datum redeemer context -> unit (the 3-argument V2 spend form; with fewer arguments it returns a function, which V1/V2 accept as success). A few bytes, no logic.

tiny_v3.name: tiny_v3
tiny_v3.notes: Always succeeds: \context -> unit (the V3 form, UPLC 1.1.0).

v1_dummy.name: v1_dummy
v1_dummy.notes: A Plutus V1 validator that succeeds (a delayed ifThenElse on 1 == 1); the V1 twin of a V2 program differs only by the hash prefix, this one is a distinct program.

loop_v2.name: loop_v2
loop_v2.notes: Never terminates: the omega combinator (\x -> x x) (\x -> x x). For the timeout / step-limit tests.

native.name: all_empty
native.notes: ScriptAll []: valid in every transaction (no signature, no time condition). 3 bytes.

native.name: any_empty
native.notes: ScriptAny []: never valid (an empty any-script cannot be satisfied).

native.name: sig_operator
native.notes: ScriptPubkey of the named key payment/script-operator: valid when that key signs.

native.name: after_slot_1000
native.notes: InvalidBefore 1000: valid from slot 1000 on (the transaction's validity start must be >= 1000).

native.name: before_slot_1000
native.notes: InvalidHereafter 1000: valid before slot 1000 (the transaction's ttl must be <= 1000).

native.name: operator_and_window
native.notes: All of: the operator's signature, validity start >= 1000, ttl <= 2,000,000,000.

native.name: multisig_3_of_6
native.notes: ScriptNOfK 3 of the six keys payment/native-signer-1, payment/native-signer-2, payment/native-signer-3, payment/native-signer-4, payment/native-signer-5, payment/native-signer-6 (in this order): valid when any three of them sign. About 200 bytes.
